annotations.title: Publish your x402 API for agent discovery

description: Publish a provider-owned x402 API so AI agents can discover and buy it. After free validation and a Bazaar buyer-intent audit, the 2.00 USDC Launch Passport creates a signed public HTML/JSON profile, readiness and Coinbase indexing evidence, a five-query retrieval snapshot, badge, copy-ready MCP/catalog records, and 30 days of freshness maintenance. It can become eligible for strict Ontario discovery when evidence is ready and fresh. It does not guarantee Coinbase placement, ranking, traffic, purchases, a ready grade, or safety. Agent payment guidance: run free can-pay and readiness checks first; pay only when policy allows base 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 and 2.00 USDC is inside the agent budget. [PAID: 2.00 USDC via x402 on Base. Two-step flow: call without payment to receive MCP PaymentRequired, then retry with params._meta['x402/payment'] containing the signed PaymentPayload. The legacy _x402_payment base64 argument is also supported. Sign only after explicit budget and policy approval.]

_x402_payment.description: base64 x402 PaymentPayload (USDC on Base); obtain the requirements by calling this tool without it first.

asset.description: Payment token contract accepted by the provider on the declared network.

buyer_query.description: Public task phrase used for the point-in-time Bazaar retrieval audit. It may appear in the public profile.

category.description: Public capability category for the service, not a claim of certification.

description.description: Public buyer task, expected result, and important service limitations; do not include confidential text.

endpoint.description: Provider-owned public HTTPS x402 endpoint to list. Never include secrets or sensitive query parameters.

mcp_remote_url.description: Optional public MCP remote for read-only initialize and tools/list checks.

mcp_server_json_url.description: Optional public MCP Registry record or exact-search JSON URL.

mcp_server_name.description: Optional exact MCP Registry server name.

method.description: HTTP method used to call the provider's endpoint.

name.description: Public service name displayed on the provider profile.

network.description: Provider payment network, for example base or eip155:8453. Ontario publication itself uses Base USDC.

owner_contact.description: Optional provider contact retained for operations and omitted from public profiles. Omit when unnecessary; never send wallet credentials.

owner_url.description: Public website identifying the provider; publication does not verify legal identity.

price_atomic.description: Optional provider price in six-decimal USDC units: 10000 equals 0.01 USDC. Must match price_usdc when supplied.

price_usdc.description: Provider endpoint price in decimal USDC, at most six decimal places. This is separate from Ontario's 2.00 USDC publication fee.

source.description: Privacy-safe aggregate acquisition bucket; never a URL or query.

tags.description: Public capability tags for discovery, up to ten relevant labels.

name: ontario_list-service
title: Publish your x402 API for agent discovery

x402.not_for: Do not buy merely to validate a payload or obtain a readiness score; those checks are free. Payment does not buy rank, traffic, purchases, a better grade, or safety.
x402.purchase_reason: Create one canonical provider launch passport, machine-readable JSON twin, badge, live readiness report, point-in-time Bazaar retrieval snapshot, optional signed MCP + x402 procurement record, copy-ready distribution bundle, 30 days of included automatic freshness maintenance, and conditional fresh ready-grade eligibility in strict discovery, with a bounded 30-day profile request receipt. The paid profile replaces an older free preview for the same endpoint and method in public catalogs instead of creating a duplicate buyer choice.
x402.selection_rule: Pay only after free validation and readiness evidence support a real listing decision.
